question: I'm an IS senior on the Dean's List. I want to take an independent study course in my final semester to pursue a cybersecurity research project with a faculty member. Is this permitted under policy?
expected_answer: Yes — P-017 is on the Dean's List, which indicates good academic standing. The restriction on independent studies applies only to students on academic actions (warning, suspension, etc.). Since P-017 is not on any academic action, she is eligible to take an independent study, subject to the standard requirements (faculty agreement, registration process, unit limits).
reasoning_type: Policy restriction scoping — applies only to students on academic actions
common_mistake: Assuming the independent study restriction is universal rather than specific to students on academic actions; conflating any senior with the restrictions that apply only to at-risk students
needs_verification: Confirm P-017's current academic standing is Dean's List or otherwise good standing (not an academic action)
Confirm whether P-017's final-semester unit count would put her at or near overload with the independent study added
Confirm the standard independent study registration process at CMU-Q (faculty must agree, units registered)
